page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 256.0 GB of total system memory, providing a high 1:8 allocation ratio of 8.0 GB RAM per dedicated compute core.

Network infrastructure for the ecs.r6.8xlarge instance offers a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The server does not bundle local disk storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage solutions for disk operations and lacking GPU support. The primary resource allocation strategy prioritizes high RAM density per core over integrated local storage.

This hardware profile delivers high qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads by maximizing available RAM per vCPU without forcing payments for unused local SSDs or GPU hardware. Best-fit workloads for the ecs.r6.8xlarge instance include large-scale in-memory key-value databases, distributed caching layers, data analytics engines, and enterprise backend platforms.
